notes: Clinical-trial demographics summary table (age/gender/race by treatment). The original read demog.xls via PROC IMPORT from an absolute path; here WORK.DEMOG is built inline with the same columns (SUBJINI DIAGDT DAY MONTH YEAR GENDER RACE TRT) and 16 realistic subjects, so the full pipeline (DATA steps, PROC MEANS/FREQ/SQL/TRANSPOSE/REPORT) runs unchanged and produces the Placebo/Active/All summary. A final PROC PRINT of t_allstats was appended so a plain curl surfaces the computed table.
